$comment: The icons this design system sanctions. Adding one means adding its name here,
running `npm run icons:sync`, and committing the resulting .svg.
Names are the Figma library's, which is Boxicons v2. The @boxicons/core npm
package is a later generation with different names for some icons — v2's
bx-right-arrow-alt is v3's bx-arrow-right, and v2's bx-error is v3's
bx-alert-triangle. Always use the name as it appears in the Figma library.
Node ids are resolved from the library file and cached here so the sync does
not have to re-read the whole 1,601-icon index on every run. If an icon is
moved or redrawn in Figma its id can change; the sync fails loudly in that
